analytics.name: Analytic 1735
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Application Versioning by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate File Modification via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: app version change detected in MDM inventory for app_package — update is the binary modification event]; Network Connection Creation via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]; Permissions Request via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Expected permission additions per app per planned update. Derived from app developer changelog and IT review.
Pre-update network domain baseline per app. Anchor to prior version. Derive by measurement.

log_sources.channel: Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: app version change detected in MDM inventory for app_package — update is the binary modification event
